content: .{@-प्रसादः, -प्रसादनम्@} [अम्बूनि प्रसादयति] the clearing nut tree (कतक <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>निवळी</ns>). Strychnos Potatorum (the nuts of this tree are used for purifying water; when rubbed on the inner surface of the vessel, they precipitate the impurities which the water contains); (फलं कतकवृक्षस्य यद्यप्यम्बुप्रसादकम् . न नामग्रहणादेव तस्य वारि प्रसीदति) <ls>Ms. 6. 67</ls>.
